frame: PCB centre origin; LED-side front view; +X right,+Y up,+Z toward LEDs; rotate the board so input DI is at -Y. Rear labels therefore read GND,DI,5V from left to right.
method: Six manually inspected pad centres; parallel equal-pitch opposite rows give projective rectification, then the green board boundary is fitted to the published166mm circle. Image measurements are nominal estimates, with no manufacturer tolerance claim.
measurement_note: The image fit residual is not a pad-position error bound. The circle, planar equal-pitch parallel row assumptions and manual landmarks do not establish manufacturing tolerances. Coordinates are rounded to0.1mm for nominal routing; this does not imply0.1mm accuracy.
assembly: Fixed rear-side soldered wires to the labelled input pads. No new PCB holes, pin headers, Dupont plugs or connection to DO. Verify labels and actual pad positions before soldering; fit the wires to the supplied board. Complete external routes and restraints are checked separately.
stencil_registration: This local terminal frame does not change the published pixel map or original stencil. Installed board-to-stencil rotation must be set with their common physical pattern; the terminal frame alone does not prove it.
